use_case_summary: Enterprise code search across a large monorepo ecosystem. Primary workload: embeddings index of code artifacts + neural reranker for precision. Requirements: sub-100ms P95 reranking for developer UX, ability to re-index deltas on commit events (minutes), and predictable cost at 100k+ queries/day. Strong security: Okta SAML SSO, SCIM user provisioning, audit logs and KMS-backed keys. Prefer dedicated pools or private deployment to control latency and data residency.
technical_requirements: Initial embedding corpus: 50M vectors (expected growth to 200M in 12 months)
Commit-triggered incremental re-indexing: target <30 minutes for high-priority repos
Reranking SLO: P95 <= 75ms, P99 <= 180ms for combined embed+rerank path
Cost target: < $0.01 per query blended (embedding lookup + rerank) at 100k qpd
Model preferences: open embeddings (semantic-code-embedding / StarCoder-derived) for licensing; fallback to smaller quantized variants for cold regions
Support for vector store sharding and hot/cold tiers; prefix/KV caching for recent commits
Batch embedding pipeline: parallelized, GPU-accelerated with checkpointing and replay for failed jobs
Integration points: webhook on commit -> incremental embedding job -> index update; audit trail for every index write
Authentication: SAML SSO (Okta), SCIM provisioning, audit logs exported to customer SIEM
On-prem agent for air-gapped repos; KMS/HSM integration required for keys

POC success criteria: relevance above BM25+tfidf baseline by measurable delta, P95 latency <= 75ms, reindex delta under 30m for hot repos

Implementation idea: use dedicated GPU pool + autoscale with burst lanes and region fallback; maintain small hot-tier cache for most-recent commits
